mapper.select: select f.flow_date as flowDate, f.batch_no as batchNo, f.downstream_type as downstreamType, f.downstream_name as downstreamName, f.quantity, c.customer_name as dealerName, m.material_name as materialName, s.shipment_no as shipmentNo from mk_dealer_sell_flow f left join mk_customer c on f.dealer_id = c.customer_id left join mk_shipment s on f.shipment_id = s.shipment_id left join wms_material m on f.material_id = m.material_id where f.batch_no = #{batchNo} order by f.flow_date desc, f.flow_id desc
